snippet.title: Game boy Advance Longplay [270] Sonic the Hedgehog - Genesis
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Tsunao

Platformer by Sonic Team to commemorate the 15th anniversary of the Blue Blur.

Follow Sanic as he jumps and spins around loop-de-loops to fight a fat egg-shaped doctor dood and other mechanical critters while searching for some mystical rocks.

Pretty much a port of the Mega Drive game of the same name.  Added was an Anniversay mode, where Sonic can do the Spin Dash introduced in Sonic 2.  Sadly, this is a REALLY REALLY bad port.  The most noticeable thing is the framerate dip.  It is prevalent throughout the WHOLE game.  I think it was something about the GBA not being able to handle, but what do I know.

This longplay drop frames through Anniversary mode while collecting the six Chaos Emeralds.  Deaths kept intact because this game is ASS and I didn't care!  Shame, this would be a good game....if it didn't have framerate drops! -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
